metadata.name: Kimono Books
metadata.description: Find books, keep what you're reading, and see what friends read.

configuration.label: Google Books key
configuration.description: From Google Cloud → APIs & Services → Credentials, with the Books API enabled. Finds more books, especially smaller and foreign ones.

configuration.label: Hardcover token
configuration.description: From hardcover.app → Settings → API. Adds readers' ratings and genres.

configuration.label: Anna's Archive address
configuration.description: The address you use for Anna's Archive, such as https://annas-archive.example. For books nothing else knows.
